why: A list item opening '(c) ...' after a page marker joined the '(b) ...' item before it. Each lettered item keeps its own row.
title: Debate on Annual Budget Statement
html:
[(proc text) Order read for Resumption of Debate on Question [25 February 2013], (proc text)]

Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast): Mdm Speaker, thank you for allowing me to participate in the Budget Debate. For "a better Singapore". That is the essence of this year's Budget.

One, reduce expenditure by:

(a) Stopping the top-up of endowment funds. I think it makes little sense to take investment income from an endowment fund, the National Reserves, to start another endowment fund;

(b) Government itself going on a productivity and cost savings drive to model behaviour to the rest of the nation. Cutting Expenditure on Manpower and Development Expenditure by 5% will save nearly $1 billion;

Page: 75

(c) Reducing Government's share in subsidising the wages of workers; and

(d) Increasing defence expenditure only at the rate of inflation.
